recentItems.title: Zarina Wahab as Zubeidaa - Glimpse (Hindi) | SlumDog - 33 Temple Road | Vijay Sethupathi | Puri J
recentItems.description:
Presenting Zarina Wahab as ZUBEIDAA Glimpse (Hindi).

SlumDog - 33 Temple Road is an upcoming gritty pan-India action drama which brings dashing director Puri Jagannadh and versatile actor Makkalselvan Vijay Sethupathi together for one of the most intriguing collaborations. Also co-stars Tabu, Samyuktha, Duniya Vijay, Zarina Wahab and others. Produced by Puri Jagannadh and Charmme Kaur under the Puri Connects banner, in collaboration with JB Narayan Rao Kondrolla's JB Motion Pictures. 

Cast & Crew Details:
Cast: Makkalselvan Vijay Sethupathi, Tabu, Samyuktha, Duniya Vijay Kumar, Zarina Wahab, VTV Ganesh, Brahmaji and Others.
